summary: GameplayKit is a game-logic framework: entities and components, state machines, pathfinding and agents, noise, decision and rule systems, and seeded randomness. BifrOSt now has pure-Rust random sources with uniform, Gaussian and shuffled-deck distributions, a named state machine, and grid route search with A*. Entities, agents, noise, strategists, rule and decision systems, and the other graph and spatial types are still missing.

features.note: No entity-component runtime in springboard/sdk/src/ or springboard/ui/src/. Apps hold their own state structs (for example springboard/apps/games-desktop/src/games.rs).

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/state_machine.rs (StateMachine, State trait); springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs (pure state machine, :320); springboard/src/shell/camera/logic.rs (countdown state machine, :99)
features.note: Named states with is_valid_next, did_enter, will_exit and update hooks, plus enter, can_enter, current_state and state_mut. States are looked up by name, not by class; there is no generic state lookup by type and no state-class bookkeeping.

features.apple: GKQuadtree, GKOctree, GKRTree (and their node types)
features.note: No quadtree, octree or R-tree in springboard/ui/src/ or springboard/sdk/src/. Hit testing is per-view.
No minimax or Monte Carlo search. The Games app (springboard/apps/games-desktop/src/games.rs) has no opponent AI.
No rule engine or decision tree. Predicate logic is written inline per app.

features.apple: GKGraph, GKGridGraph, GKObstacleGraph, GKMeshGraph, GKGraphNode and subclasses
features.note: Grid graph only: an integer grid with an origin, optional diagonal steps that never cut a blocked corner, blocked cells, and A* route search with integer costs. Missing: obstacle graphs, mesh graphs, custom node classes, graph nodes in 2D or 3D space, and adding nodes at run time.

features.apple: GKAgent2D, GKAgent3D, GKGoal, GKBehavior, GKCompositeBehavior, GKPath, GKAgentDelegate
features.note: No steering or agent movement code in the SDK or the UI crate. Motion code in springboard/render/src/motion.rs is for shell animation, not agents.
No obstacle primitives. Depends on the agent row; the grid graph's blocked cells are the only obstacle form.

features.apple: GKNoise, GKNoiseMap, GKPerlinNoiseSource, GKVoronoiNoiseSource and other noise sources
features.bifrost: springboard/apps/games-desktop/src/games.rs (rand); springboard/src/shell/kb_clicks.rs:34 (ad hoc click noise, not an API)
features.note: No coherent noise (Perlin, Voronoi, billow, ridged) in the SDK, the UI crate or the render crate. The only noise is an inline hash in kb_clicks.rs and a shader dither in springboard/src/gpu/wl.rs:280.

features.apple: GKRandomSource, GKARC4RandomSource, GKLinearCongruentialRandomSource, GKMersenneTwisterRandomSource, GKRandomDistribution, GKGaussianDistribution, GKShuffledDistribution
features.bifrost: springboard/core/src/random.rs (RandomSource, Xorshift64, SplitMix64, RandomDistribution, GaussianDistribution, ShuffledDistribution, shuffle); springboard/sdk/src/testing.rs:52 (seed(), PINNED_SEED); springboard/apps/games-desktop/src/games.rs:150 (xorshift rand); springboard/apps/music-desktop/src/music/upnext.rs:19 (shuffle_slice, Fisher-Yates)
features.note: Pure random sources (xorshift64 and splitmix64, both seeded) with uniform whole-number ranges, a die helper, real-valued uniform values, Gaussian values by Box-Muller, shuffled-deck distributions and a Fisher-Yates shuffle. Missing: the ARC4, linear congruential and Mersenne Twister sources by name, and a source that is not a 64-bit word stream. The SDK does not expose these yet; apps still copy their own xorshift.
Tied to Apple's SpriteKit and SceneKit scene graphs and the Xcode editor. BifrOSt has no SpriteKit or SceneKit equivalent.

features.apple: GKGameModelMaxScore, GKGameModelMinScore, GKBox, GKQuad, GKTriangle, GKMeshGraphTriangulationMode, GKRTreeSplitStrategy
features.note: Value types for the spatial, mesh and strategist rows are missing. Cell is the only grid value type so far.

gaps: No SDK pathfinding beyond the grid graph: no obstacle graph, mesh graph, custom node classes or route search over continuous space.
No SDK random source by name (ARC4, linear congruential, Mersenne Twister), and the new random module is not yet exposed to apps; apps still copy an xorshift generator.
No procedural noise (Perlin, Voronoi, billow, ridged) for apps.
No entity-component system, and no rule or decision system for game logic.
No spatial partitioning (quadtree, octree, R-tree) for apps.
No turn-based AI (minimax or Monte Carlo strategist) or agent steering (goals, behaviors, obstacles).
The state machine finds states by name, not by class; there is no state lookup by type.
SpriteKit and SceneKit integration has no BifrOSt counterpart, so it is n/a.
